It is a single test-local constant inside the one describe block that spawns a subprocess, it is the only per-test budget in ts/ (`grep -rn -i timeout ts/` returns only `setTimeout` at render.test.ts:369, and bunfig.toml sets none), nothing outside that block reads it, and it is reversible by deleting one line.
observations.nonBlockingReason: rails-decisions' boundary puts it on the agent's side: "Local work with no blast radius: a loop, a helper's internals, a private name, how one function is coded — cheaply changed later with no ripple", and "How a named thing is internally coded (a loop, a helper, a name) is implementation, not a decision, and needs no sign-off." Raising a clock budget also weakens no assertion, so the contract's "Weaken, skip or delete a test" ban is not touched.
